title: Moonlit Garden Friends

settings.subtitle: A Relaxing Coloring Book of Original Night-Garden Animals
settings.author: Your Pen Name

book_description:
A calm, detailed coloring book set in an enchanted night garden. Every page features original woodland and garden animals among moonflowers, ferns, mushrooms and lanterns. The mood is peaceful and cozy, never scary.

Put the most important points first. You can write up to 10,000 words here; give each character or place its own paragraph.
master_style: Black-and-white adult coloring book page, pure white background, no grayscale shading, intricate indie pen-and-ink line art, fine-liner style, delicate botanical stippling and organic woodgrain cross-hatching, crisp enclosed shapes, vertical 8.5x11 aspect ratio, full-page composition.

back_cover_text: Slow down and color your way through a moonlit garden. 40 original, detailed illustrations printed on one side of the page.
